name: Branch Repair
description: Repair the visually marked connected fibre in an opaque-labelled glass specimen. Linked orthogonal slices and a rotatable reconstruction reveal missing continuations and false joins.
natural_language: Repair the marked fibre without absorbing its neighbours.

metadata.variant_count_kind: five active difficulty profiles with deterministic opaque-labelled fibre geometry and recoverable split/merge errors
metadata.notes: The two input surfaces share generated geometry, linked slice records, target anchor, and grading truth. Public segment labels and identifiers do not encode fibre membership or position; the target fibre and construction truth remain server-side. Full input adds direct scroll, mesh orbit, mesh-node merge, and slice seed placement; simplified input exposes labelled equivalents.
